content: {"episode_id":"ep-05146","cpt":"93226","denial_carc":"CO-29","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for CPT 93226, denied under CO-29 for expiration of the filing time limit. The clinical indication documents recurrent dizziness and transient loss of consciousness in the context of known sick sinus syndrome, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia. A 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmias or pauses that may not be captured on a standard electrocardiogram."}
